title: Stock market news articles
description: Normalized financial news articles from RSS/Atom feeds. One dataset item per article.

overview.title: News articles
overview.description: Latest stock market headlines sorted by publication date.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article title with HTML tags and entities removed.
headline.example: US Stocks Rise as Indexes on Track for Best Quarter Since 2020

source.title: Source
source.description: Publisher or feed name (e.g. Bloomberg Markets, Yahoo Finance).

author.title: Author
author.description: Article author from RSS when available; null otherwise.

publishedDate.title: Published date
publishedDate.description: Publication timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC. Null if the feed omits a date.

articleLink.title: Article URL
articleLink.description: Canonical article link with UTM and tracking query params removed.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: RSS description or snippet, truncated to 320 characters. May be empty when the publisher omits it.
summary.example: US equities climbed as investors weighed economic data.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: RSS category tags for the article.

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: Thumbnail or media image URL from the RSS feed when present.

tickers.title: Detected tickers
tickers.description: Stock symbols detected in headline and summary (e.g. $AAPL, NYSE: MSFT, or company names like Apple), plus the ticker of any per-ticker feed the article came from.

companyDetails.title: Company details
companyDetails.description: Well-known companies mentioned in the article with ticker, name, exchange, and sector. Present when enrichArticles is true.

eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.description: Rule-based event tags: earnings, guidance, mergers_acquisitions, analyst_rating, ipo, dividends_buybacks, legal_regulatory, executive_change, layoffs_restructuring, macro. Present when enrichArticles is true.

sentimentScore.title: Sentiment score
sentimentScore.description: Finance word-list sentiment from -1 (negative) to 1 (positive). Best-effort; present when enrichArticles is true.

sentimentLabel.title: Sentiment label
sentimentLabel.description: positive (score >= 0.2), negative (score <= -0.2), or neutral. Present when enrichArticles is true.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Google News search query that produced the article; null for feed articles.

fullText.title: Full text
fullText.description: Readable article body text, truncated to fullTextMaxChars. Present when includeFullText is true; null when extraction was skipped or failed.
fullText.example: Tesla Inc. delivered 95,366 China-made electric vehicles in September...

fullTextStatus.title: Full text status
fullTextStatus.description: ok, paywalled, unsupported (e.g. Google News links), empty, or failed. Present when includeFullText is true.

fullTextError.title: Full text error
fullTextError.description: Error detail when fullTextStatus is failed (e.g. HTTP 403, timeout).

dedupeKey.title: Deduplication key
dedupeKey.description: Stable key for cross-feed and cross-run deduplication. Usually equals articleLink.

sourceFeed.title: Source feed URL
sourceFeed.description: RSS/Atom feed URL this article was collected from.

fetchedAt.title: Fetched at
fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this Actor run collected the article.
